h:
本质上，它只是常规的修复，但是当我们添加 LoRA 时，它非常适合脸部交换，或者可能是服装或衣服，具体取决于您想如何使用它。

温馨提示

  • 降噪 0.65 - 0.75 采样器（保留原始）

  • 步骤 4 - 8，res_multistep |欧拉，简单 | sgm_制服

  • LoRA 权重 1 - 1.4 取决于您的 LoRA

o.en:
Essentially, it's just regular inpaint, But when we adding LoRA, It makes great for face swaps, or maybe outfits or clothing, depending on how you want to use it.

Tips

  • denoise 0.65 - 0.75 sampler (To preserve the original)

  • step 4 - 8 , res_multistep | euler, simple | sgm_uniform

  • LoRA weight 1 - 1.4 depend on yours LoRA
